newsitem.title: USA: Lernout provides technology to Acer Sertek.
newsitem.headline: Lernout provides technology to Acer Sertek.

text.p: Lernout & Hauspie Speech Products N.V. said that it licensed its automatic speech recognition technology to Acer Sertek Inc, a Taiwanese multimedia software developer.

Lernout & Hauspie said it has been strong in Asia in providing coding and text-to-speech technologies, however, the contract with Acer Sertek, represents the company's first entry of speech recognition in the Asian market.
Lernout & Hauspie said that through its Taipei and Hong Kong offices, it will provide local support for its customers. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
